title: Liapoldus security runtime contract

modes.require: missing or invalid client certificate is 401 mtls_required
modes.optional: missing certificate is allowed; supplied certificate must validate

mtls.identity: RE2 mapping applies to verified certificate subject/SAN only.

sourceIp: The TCP/UDP peer address is sourceIp. X-Forwarded-For is never trusted for auth, WAF, rate-limit source-ip or geo/ASN lookup.

managementApi.remoteListener: A non-loopback management.listener requires tlsProfile with clientAuth.mode=require. The TLS client certificate is verified before HTTP parsing, then every /api/* request also requires a valid platform-admin Bearer service key.
managementApi.health: /healthz remains unauthenticated readiness only; it does not disclose configuration or runtime inventory.

geo.city: English city name from the MMDB city.names map
geo.asn: non-negative integer returned by the local MaxMind MMDB reader
geo.onErrorPrecedence: The matching WAF rule onError overrides the referenced data provider onError; if omitted, provider onError applies; if both are omitted, deny applies. A missing MMDB record is a failed lookup.
geo.reload: A new MMDB is opened and checked before atomic replacement; a failed reload keeps the old reader. With no reader or failed lookup, the matching WAF rule applies its onError.

matcherComposition: Поля matcher-а и композиционные группы объединяются через AND. Дочерние элементы all и any проверяются слева направо в порядке YAML. Ошибка provider lookup даёт неизвестный результат: доказанный false определяет all как false, доказанный true определяет any как true; иначе применяется onError правила. not передаёт неизвестный результат дальше, не инвертируя его. Пустой all равен true, пустой any — false.

requestSize.measuredBytes: Actual body octets after HTTP transfer framing is removed; excludes request line, headers, and chunk framing. Chunked bodies are measured from received bytes, not Content-Length.
requestSize.evaluation: If any active matcher node uses requestSize, Gateway reads and preserves the request body before WAF evaluation, then forwards the same bytes to the selected upstream or plugin.
requestSize.limit: Bounded by listener.limits.bodyBytes; exceeding it returns 413 body_too_large before upstream or plugin dispatch.
requestSize.threshold: Non-negative integer bytes or a string with KiB, MiB, or GiB suffix; gt/gte/lt/lte use strict/inclusive comparison semantics.

tls.storage: ${registry.path}/tls/<storage>/{accounts,certificates,orders}/. Files containing account or private keys are mode 0600 and owned by the Gateway user. Plugins receive opaque handles only.
tls.sni: Choose exact DNS SAN first; otherwise the longest matching wildcard SAN. No matching certificate fails TLS handshake.
tls.http3: protocols including h3 requires a terminating TLS profile and binds TCP and UDP on the same listener address. QUIC limits are listener.limits.quic; TCP limits still apply independently.
tls.degraded: Repeated renew failure while a valid certificate exists is degraded and serves the valid certificate. At expiry Gateway stops new handshakes for affected SNI, returns tls_degraded where HTTP is possible, emits alert/audit and expiry metric.
